query:
SELECT
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'image') AS "images!",
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE char_length(coalesce(new_content, '')) = 0) AS "empty!",
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE char_length(btrim(coalesce(content, ''))) > 4000) AS "long!"
           FROM legacy.ik_messages
